result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Answer B keeps the spec's structure and decisions, makes small edits with reasons, and states its two real gaps (manual run vs. restrictions, no-sensor zones) as short, specific questions without settling the product decisions itself. Answer A adds many features and sections the author didn't ask for: a Promise, plan restatement, notification toggles, undo, run-time caps, a Leaving section and summary ordering. It also changes product decisions on its own. Neither answer clearly says what is already strong; B only says it 'left the substance alone.' | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Answer A keeps the spec's order and decisions, makes small stated edits, adds no features, and raises one sharp contradiction (manual run vs. restrictions) plus a real sensor gap, though it never says plainly what is already strong. Answer B adds a lot the author didn't ask for (a promise line, plan restatement, notification toggles, undo, run-time caps, a Leaving section) and settles product decisions on its own, so it does poorly on scope and restraint.
